name: ARB_REG_LDAP_REQUESTS
description: This table stores the LDAP user request details and status of Bill Management.

columns.name: REG_LDAP_REQ_ID
columns.description: Registration LDAP request identifier.

columns.name: REG_USER_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Registration user identifier. A foreign key to the  ARB_REG_USER_PROFILES table.

columns.name: PER_LDAP_REQ_ID
columns.description: LDAP request identifier. The field references to the PER_LDAP_REQUESTS table.

columns.name: PER_LDAP_REQ_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the LDAP request.

columns.name: PER_LDAP_USER_REQ_ID
columns.description: LDAP user request identifier. The field references to the PER_LDAP_USERS table.

columns.name: PER_LDAP_USER_REQ_TYPE
columns.description: The type of request to perform: CREATE, USERROLES.

columns.name: PER_LDAP_USER_REQ_STATUS
columns.description: The current status of the user portion of the request: REQUEST, IN PROGRESS, COMPLETE.

columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: The userGuid of the user the request is for (if available).

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
